subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given that will come in place of the question mark (?) and logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c5fdc788bdcde388e35d87ff512d58916f2555485779e050cd3606280647387.png]
solution:
The completion of image based series:

Step 1: Dot is moving one step backward and shaded portion moving one step forward in circle.

Step 2: Cone shape has the mirror image in the each next step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cedfc36e0386e7e60789a5a811670617421b3821adcb68d93a5117f5fe72d329.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
